notes: Hard bucket (sum 18): the agent must bring up a tiny guest under software-only QEMU TCG with a telnet-served monitor and a TCP-redirected serial console, keep the emulator alive as a background service, wait for the guest boot markers, and drive the guest's serial shell over the loopback port to mount a tmpfs, compute a scenario-dependent result in-guest with shell arithmetic, and read the tokenized answer back off the serial line. Hidden cases re-execute /app/run.sh on genuinely different scenarios (different operands, operation, token, loopback ports) and the verifier independently probes both the monitor HMP console and the live serial shell. Difficulty comes from dependent virtualization stages, background-service/socket statefulness, interactive serial-protocol driving (marker/prompt synchronization), and diagnosing guest-side failures indirectly.
